name: Rupert

intro.text: Rupert, Oxford. We punt from the sloped end, the proper end, the right end. Shall we race? First to the Mathematical Bridge.
On your marks. Mind the pole. Mind the Japanese tourists. Mind the swan, he's a menace.

win: Good heavens. Beaten by a till-stander.
after: Do tell your captain I'll be back. In Oxford. Where we'll never speak of this.
